title: M5 Source Reconnaissance and Baseline Audit

aota_forge.core.contracts.findings: Provides foundational OperationContractDescriptor, HandlerRegistry, MutationResult, LifecycleResult, and error types. Cleanly separates descriptor metadata from executable handlers. Fully retained.

aota_forge.core.findings: Implements M1-M4 closed mutation plane (plan_init, plan_retirement), capability lease validation, trusted context resolution, and TransactionStore. Fully retained. New execution plane will be housed in aota_forge.core.execution.

aota_forge.core.journal.findings: Implements durable external mutation journal, CAS state machine, 3-way reconciliation, and recovery scanner for plan mutation operations. Retained intact.

aota_forge.adapters.hermes.findings: Contains M2-F thin ingress adapter and request schema. In M5, this directory will be extended with executor.py to implement ExecutorAdapter for Hermes host.

aota_forge.adapters.host.findings: Read-only host diagnostics and process inspection without worker orchestration. Retained intact.

aota_forge.adapters.plan_authority.findings: Portable Plan authority adapter and GitHub Issue/control-comment implementation. Retained intact.

aota_forge.cli.findings: Canonical CLI transport adapter. In M5, commands/task.py and commands/executor.py (or commands/execution.py) will be added to project execution operations.

tests.findings: 129 tests passing with 0 failures at base SHA b91aa7fd8ecd8219fab8386e00c098296b9c0c7b. Modernized fixtures and historical guards intact.
